metadata.description: Indexed public Claude.ai shared conversations and artifacts from web search and Common Crawl
notes: Claude share/artifact pages are client-side rendered; titles often require JavaScript
Most indexed pages use generic og:title ('Claude' or 'Claude Artifact')
Share links expire after a period (typically 7+ days for conversations)
Public artifacts are interactive apps/documents created in Claude

artifacts.title: Claude's Complete System Prompt Structure
artifacts.description: Try out Artifacts created by Claude users
artifacts.snippet: August 15, 2025 - - For structured reference content (meal plans, workout schedules, study guides, etc.), prefer markdown artifacts as they're easily saved and referenced by users - **Strictly limit to one artifact per response** - use the update mechanism for corrections - Focus on creating complete, functional solutions - For code artifacts: Use concise variable names (e.g., `i`, `j` for indices, `e` for event, `el` for element) to maximize content within context limits while maintaining readability # CRITICAL BROWSER STORAGE RESTRICTION **NEVER use localStorage, sessionStorage, or ANY browser storage APIs in artifacts.** These APIs are NOT supported and will cause artifacts to fail in the Claude.ai environment.
